actual_checks: Complete prompt, API/meta, author/source records, report and both full prior bodies read. Earlier graph/multisection and path arguments do not cover the imported global theorem for every closed embedded exact Lagrangian. The other prior announcement is treated as unverified data; no Hamiltonian-isotopy solution is asserted.

Checked connected closed smooth base and closed connected embedded exact Lagrangian. The conclusion concerns the canonical projection as a simple homotopy equivalence, without graph, immersion, covering, Maslov or spin hypotheses added. It does not make the projection a diffeomorphism or supply ambient Hamiltonian isotopy.

For an arbitrary cotangent symplectomorphism, image of a lens-space zero section is closed embedded Lagrangian; the restricted Liouville form is closed. Finite first homology gives H1(L;R)=0, hence exactness by de Rham. The simple-homotopy theorem and the explicitly cited standard lens-space classification corollary then imply diffeomorphism.

The converse cotangent lift has the displayed inverse-transpose covector formula and preserves the Liouville form by evaluation. The argument applies to standard smooth lens spaces of dimension >=3 as in the source; it does not identify simple homotopy with diffeomorphism for arbitrary manifolds.
